Path fit S (events/live entertainment): the plan is protocol/events management, entirely non-technical (Protocolo Oficial, Restauración y Catering, Producción Escenografía y Diseño de Eventos, Organización de Congresos Convenciones Ferias y Exposiciones) and includes 6 ECTS Prácticas Empresa. ects: 60 ('Nº de Créditos ECTS: 60 ECTS', 'Duración del Máster: Un curso académico'; RUCT: obligatorios 48 + optativos 6 + TFM 6 = 60, prácticas 0). MUSA site: 30 ECTS per semester.
modality: 'Modalidad: Presencial'. 'Lugar: Campus de Móstoles'. 'Centro responsable: Escuela Técnica Superior de Ingeniería Informática'. 'Orientación: Profesional'. 'Oferta de plazas: 20 plazas. Si en un curso no se alcanzara el número mínimo de alumnos previsto, la Universidad podrá optar por no abrir el grupo de docencia.' — i.e. the group can be cancelled for low enrolment.

Checked the URJC official programme page (its datasheet has no 'idioma' row at all), the master's own site blogs.etsii.urjc.es/musa (información, plan de estudios, estructura — no language statement), and URJC's official list of 'Másteres universitarios en habla inglesa' at /estudios/master/1841-..., which lists only Business Organization, International Economic Relations Analysis, International Tourism Management, Audiovisual Animation (TAI), Documentary and Art Photograph, Screen Acting and the Erasmus Mundus GCEB — this master is NOT among them. Strong primary evidence it is taught in Spanish, but I am recording NOT FOUND rather than asserting 'castellano', because no page states it verbatim. Needs a human to open a guía docente at https://gestion3.urjc.es/guiasdocentes.
tuition_total_eur: EUR 5,044.20 for the non-EU non-resident population (84,07 EUR/crédito x 60 ECTS = 5.044,20) (2026-27 rates). EU/resident first-enrolment comparison: 45,02 x 60 = EUR 2,701.20. Add 'Apertura de expediente académico 27,54 €' + 'Gastos de secretaría 6,11 €' + 'Seguro escolar 1,12 €' = 34,77 €; 'Expedición de Título Oficial de Máster Universitario 176,27 €' on graduation; 'Estudio de solicitudes de reconocimiento y transferencia de créditos y de convalidación (centros extranjeros) 70,00 €' if claiming recognition for the 300-ECTS degree.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27 — the URJC page is headed 'Precios públicos de servicios académicos universitarios. Curso 2026/2027', applying DECRETO 43/2022, de 29 de junio, del Consejo de Gobierno de la Comunidad de Madrid. URJC warns the figure can be adjusted if a new Decreto supersedes it mid-course.
non_eu_surcharge: YES — explicit and severe, and it is the single most important cost fact for this candidate. URJC's 'PRECIOS PÚBLICOS DE LAS RESTANTES ENSEÑANZAS DE MÁSTER' table has a column headed '3ª Matrícula y sucesivas Y ESTUDIANTES EXTRACOMUNITARIOS, NO RESIDENTES *' at 84,07 €/crédito, against 'Estudiantes Residentes' 1ª matrícula 45,02 € — the non-EU student pays the third-enrolment rate from day one, +86.7%. The footnote closes the obvious escape route verbatim: '*La autorización de estancia concedida a los estudiantes extranjeros de acuerdo con el Real Decreto 557/2011, de 20 de abril ... no equivaldrá a la condición de residentes'. URJC restates the same rule in prose for grados ('cobrará a los estudiantes extranjeros mayores de dieciocho años que no tengan la condición de residentes, excluidos los nacionales de Estados miembros de la Unión Europea ... los precios de cuarta matrícula'). So a Tunisian student living in Madrid on a student visa cannot reach the resident price.
complementary_credits_required: (a) FOR THE TITLE, from RUCT: 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' not published for this title (null) = NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT. (b) FOR THE APPLICANT: the URJC access page is unusually explicit and it works IN THIS CANDIDATE'S FAVOUR on the degree bar but leaves complementos open. 'Grado en Ingeniería del Software' and 'Grado en Ingeniería Informática' are both named among 'las titulaciones específicas que facilitarán el acceso al Máster', and it adds 'Otros grados o títulos oficiales que incluyan en su plan de estudios asignaturas de programación, bases de datos, y aprendizaje automático. Los solicitantes deben tener una formación básica en programación y estadística.' BUT the only profile the page declares exempt is Physics/Maths: 'Los graduados en Física y Matemáticas son considerados aptos para acceder al Máster ... SIN LA NECESIDAD DE COMPLEMENTOS DE FORMACIÓN' — an exemption stated for those two degrees and not for engineering, so complementos for a software-engineering graduate are possible and NOT ruled out — NOT FOUND for this candidate specifically. Ceiling: the same page quotes RD 822/2021 — complementos formativos 'no podrá superar el equivalente al 20 por ciento de la carga crediticia del título', i.e. max 12 ECTS here, 'tendrán la misma consideración que el resto de los créditos', so they would be billed at 84,07 €/crédito too (up to +1.008,84 €). No 300-ECTS advanced-standing rule is published; URJC charges 70 € to assess a foreign-credit recognition request.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 DATES NOT YET PUBLISHED. The full 2026-27 calendar IS published and I am recording it as 2026-27, not shifted forward — from URJC's 'MÁSTERES UNIVERSITARIOS - CALENDARIO DE AUTOPREINSCRIPCIÓN Y MATRÍCULA - CURSO ACADÉMICO 2026-2027': 1er PERIODO ORDINARIO preinscripción 13 February – 2 March 2026 (admitidos provisional 12 Mar, subsanación 13–17 Mar, definitivos 23 Mar, automatrícula 25–26 Mar 2026); 2º PERIODO ORDINARIO 25 March – 26 April 2026 (8 May / 9–12 May / 22 May / 25–27 May); 3er PERIODO ORDINARIO 25 May – 24 June 2026 (6 Jul / 7–11 Jul / 17 Jul / 20–22 Jul); PERIODO EXTRAORDINARIO 24 August – 2 September 2026 (9 Sep / 10–13 Sep / 18 Sep / automatrícula 22–23 Sep 2026). Note the extraordinary period only offers másteres with vacancies. For a Sept-2027 intake a non-EU applicant should target the equivalent 1st ordinary period (mid-February 2027) to leave time for visa and legalisation.
notes: RUCT code confirmed register-side (exact title + university, single hit) and cross-checked against BOE-A-2026-1243, the URJC resolution publishing this master's plan de estudios. ⚠️ Do not mistake URJC's 'Código del título: 6412' on the programme page for a RUCT code — it is URJC's internal code; the RUCT code 3500565 is not printed on the page. The programme page reachable at /estudios/master/9586-master-universitario-en-analisis-de-datos-deportivos (an older /master/3542- URL also resolves). urjc.es serves curl normally (first request may return a 202 shell; retry with a browser User-Agent). Path fit AB, narrowed to sport: the plan is data science applied to sports performance, 20 plazas, ETSII Móstoles. Access criteria explicitly welcome software-engineering graduates, which makes this one of the more open targets in this batch on the degree bar — the cost, not the eligibility, is the obstacle.

programme_name: Máster de Formación Permanente en Ciencia e Ingeniería de Datos
official_status: título propio — NOT an official máster universitario. 'Máster de Formación Permanente' is the post-RD 822/2021 legal name for a título propio: no ANECA verification, NO PhD access, no MECES level, and normally ineligible for public scholarships (Becas MEC). Verified absent from RUCT three ways: (1) no matching row in output/ruct-backbone.jsonl; (2) a direct query with .masters-search/spain/ruct.py 'ciencia e ingenieria de datos' returns ZERO rows (accent-stripped, fresh session — the two traps the script handles); (3) URJC itself files it under /estudios/formacion-continua/, its continuing-education catalogue, not under /estudios/master/. The correction to brief rule 6 (Enseñanzas Artísticas) does not apply here — this is a university title, so RUCT absence is decisive.
ects: NOT FOUND from a primary source. The URJC detail page is gone (see application_window/notes); an indexed/aggregator figure of 60 credits circulates but I will not state it as fact.
modality: NOT FOUND from a primary source. Indexed/aggregator descriptions say presencial in Madrid; unverifiable while the page is down.
language_of_instruction: NOT FOUND. No primary page states it. (All surviving URJC catalogue text for this title is in Spanish, and it sits in the Ingeniería y Arquitectura block of the Spanish-language formación continua catalogue, but that is not an 'idioma de impartición' statement.)
tuition_total_eur: NOT FOUND. A figure of EUR 4,500 appears in aggregator listings (educaweb) and in the search-index remnant of the removed URJC page; per brief rule 1 an aggregator may discover but never state a fact, and the URJC page that would confirm it no longer resolves. Recorded as NOT FOUND rather than repeated. NOTE this would in any case be a título-propio price set by the university, outside the Comunidad de Madrid decreto de precios públicos.

non_eu_surcharge: NOT FOUND — checked explicitly and cannot be checked further: título propio prices sit outside DECRETO 43/2022 of the Comunidad de Madrid, so URJC's published 84,07 €/crédito extracomunitario rate (which applies to its OFFICIAL másteres) does NOT govern this title, and the title's own price page is gone. Do not carry the official-master surcharge over to this record.
complementary_credits_required: NOT APPLICABLE / NOT FOUND. (a) FOR THE TITLE: no RUCT row exists at all, so there is no 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' to read — this is absence of a register entry, not a published 0. (b) FOR THE APPLICANT: no admission page survives to state a rule. Note that complementos de formación are a mechanism of the official-master framework (RD 822/2021 art. 18); a título propio sets its own entry rules.
application_window_2027: NO WINDOW — AND THIS PROGRAMME APPEARS NOT TO RUN. As of 2026-08-25 URJC's own detail page for it, https://www.urjc.es/estudios/formacion-continua/1332-master-de-formacion-permanente-en-ciencia-e-ingenieria-de-datos, returns HTTP 200 with URJC's 'Página no encontrada — No se ha encontrado ninguna página que cumpla los requisitos de búsqueda' body (reproduced on three separate requests, and identically via the alternate /component/k2/1332-... route, so it is not a transient block). Its two component titles are ALSO gone: /estudios/formacion-continua/9207-especialista-en-ciencia-de-datos and /9206-especialista-en-ingenieria-de-datos both return the same 404 page. The only trace left is a stale link in the formación continua index at /estudios/formacion-continua, which still lists 'Máster de formación permanente en ciencia e ingeniería de datos' under Ingeniería y Arquitectura → MÁSTER DE FORMACIÓN PERMANENTE. Note that in the same index a sibling title is explicitly tagged 'NO OFERTADO CURSO 23/24', so URJC does mark withdrawn titles there — this one is not tagged, it has simply lost its page. Verdict: cannot be confirmed as offered for 2026-27, let alone 2027-28.
notes: ⚠️ FLAG FOR THE ORCHESTRATOR: this is the one target in this batch that appears not to run, and it is also the one target that is NOT an official degree. Both facts point the same way — it should not be ranked alongside the másteres universitarios. For a candidate whose goals include PhD access and public funding, a Máster de Formación Permanente is disqualifying regardless of price. Everything I could not source here is unsourceable because URJC has withdrawn the pages, not because the domain blocked me: www.urjc.es served every other URL I requested normally (its first response can be an HTTP 202 shell; a retry with a browser User-Agent returns the full body). Academic director named in the search-index remnant: Isaac Martín de Diego; formación continua contact 91 665 5060 — NEEDS A HUMAN to phone or email URJC Formación Continua to establish whether the title is still offered and at what price. Separately: do not confuse this with URJC's GRADO en Ciencia e Ingeniería de Datos at /estudios/master/7087-ciencia-e-ingenieria-de-datos, which despite sitting on a '/master/' URL is a 240-ECTS, 4-year undergraduate degree ('Créditos: 240', 'Duración: 4 años', Escuela de Ingeniería de Fuenlabrada) — a trap for a title-matcher.
